title: metais.skill/1
description: What metais skill prints with --json: what it did, or with --dry-run would do, to each SKILL.md it decided, or with --print the skill's text (ADR-008 A2 item 8).

skill.description: The skill's name, its directory's name beneath each skills directory.

version.description: The version of metais whose skill this is, as metais version prints it.

chosen.description: flag when --harness named the targets, detected when the directory did; null with --print.

targets.description: Each SKILL.md decided, .claude/skills before .agents/skills; empty with --print.

text.description: With --print, the skill as metais skill writes it, its stamp line last; otherwise null.

path.description: The file's path relative to the directory, which is never echoed.

harnesses.description: The harnesses that read this file: the --harness values that share its directory, or under detection every harness that does.

because.description: Why it is a target: flag, or the harness directory whose existence chose it.

action.description: What was done to it, or with --dry-run would be: installed where there was none; unchanged for this version's own copy; updated for a copy another version wrote, unedited; edited for a copy metais did not write or someone changed, left as it is; replaced for such a copy with --overwrite.

from.description: The version in the stamp of the copy found, when its digest matched; otherwise null.
